precedence: This override is authoritative only for the standalone public 11plus.futureperfect.education marketing-video surface. It does not alter authenticated Portal V2, Admin, Quiz, Trial, student access, lesson release, protected resources, parent email, catalogue, or read-model semantics.

visibleCopy.title: Preparing for the 11+
visibleCopy.description: See why our approach to the 11+ is different.
visibleCopy.supportingCopy: Small batches, personal attention and purposeful practice — designed to spot gaps early, keep learning secure and prepare children to think when the exam doesn’t look like the practice.

updateRule.sameVideoProviderReplacement: Replace only the ScreenPal ID/embed URL on this isolated Worker, preserve 11plus.futureperfect.education and the Portal-style presentation, verify live iframe source and absence of autoplay.
